name: Git
author: ariadev
description: GitHub, GitLab and Gitea open work: a full-year contribution graph, review queue, and your open pull/merge requests in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: per-provider full-year activity graph, a grid of review/assignment counts, and click-to-open queues of merge requests and issues. Multiple hosts per provider (GitHub Enterprise, self-managed GitLab and Gitea) switch inside the tab.
